purpose.en: Practice gentle spinal movement from a stable quadruped position.

text.zh: 收腹拱背，缓慢抬胸，手脚保持稳定
text.en: Round your back, then gently lift your chest, keeping your hands and knees still

text.zh: 手掌与膝盖保持稳定支撑，慢慢活动脊柱
text.en: Keep your palms and knees stable as you gently move your spine.

text.zh: 头颈跟随躯干自然活动，保持呼吸
text.en: Let your head and neck follow the torso naturally and keep breathing.

commonErrors.en: Moving too quickly or throwing the head.

commonErrors.zh: 手脚不断移动，支撑位置失稳
commonErrors.en: Shifting the hands and knees and losing a stable base.

cautions.zh: 手腕与肩：手掌稳固承托，肩部不过度耸起，手腕不适时改用已审核的坐姿替代。
cautions.en: Wrists and shoulders: keep the palms supported without shrugging; use a reviewed seated alternative if wrist loading is uncomfortable.

cautions.zh: 膝：使用舒适垫面，膝盖支撑位置保持稳定。
cautions.en: Knees: use comfortable padding and keep the knee support positions stable.

cautions.zh: 腰背与颈：缓慢在舒适范围内活动，头颈自然跟随躯干，不猛抬头或强行塌腰。
cautions.en: Back and neck: move slowly within a comfortable range, letting the head follow the trunk without throwing it back or forcing the lower back.
